title: Crimson Rite
description:
There was peace between humans, elves, dwarves and even orcs. As a lone wanderer, you try to find a place to camp in the forest. After you venturing deeper into the forest, you find a campsite. But deep in the dark forest, you never know what you might encounter.

You are kidnapped by an outcast tribe of orcs. As you learn why this tribe is abducting people, you'll try to escape the orc stronghold.

A retro survival horror adventure featuring:
• Explore the stronghold to find a way out.

• Uncover the story of an outcast tribe of orcs.

• Find clues and solve puzzles.

• Fight orcs to reach the exit.

• Tank control as in retro survival horror classics.
description_short: In times of peace, a lone wanderer decides to camp for the night. He faces an unexpected attack from an orc. Trying to find out why he has been kidnapped, then learns the dark history of an outcast orc tribe. You must escape before the Crimson Rite.
